name: Kraken
label: Kraken — Kraken REST 0
description: Official Kraken REST 0. Docs: https://docs.kraken.com/api/. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. Crypto exchange ToS; geo KYC. Not investment advice. Private methods require API-Sign (engine limitation).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Kraken. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: ticker | ohlc | balance | add_order | cancel_order | ledgers. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: pair
schema.description: Asset pair for ticker / ohlc / add_order. Example: XBTUSD.

schema.label: interval
schema.description: OHLC interval minutes. Official interval. Typical: 1 | 5 | 15 | 60 | 1440.

schema.label: nonce
schema.description: Increasing nonce for private POSTs (balance, add_order, cancel_order, ledgers). Kraken also requires API-Sign HMAC which this handler cannot compute — private ops will 401 without an external signer.

schema.label: ordertype
schema.description: add_order ordertype. EXACT: market | limit | stop-loss | take-profit | stop-loss-limit | take-profit-limit.

schema.label: volume
schema.description: Order volume in base currency for add_order. Example: 0.01.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: ticker | ohlc | balance | add_order | cancel_order | ledgers. Default ticker. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Kraken API-Key header. StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged. Private endpoints also require API-Sign (HMAC of the private secret); OfficialApiNode cannot HMAC, so signed private methods cannot work.
